messages:
Marissa: Heads-up — Acme just flagged two charges for the same renewal. They sent screenshots, want a reversal on the duplicate. Invoice IDs: INV-20260315-9988 and INV-20260315-9989. Customer account: acct_004532.

Liam: Thanks Marissa. Escalating to billing + eng. Can we confirm if both invoices actually captured funds? :eyes:

Priya: Looking now — both invoices are in our billing DB and both map to successful Stripe charges: charge_1JxA9... and charge_1JxA9... (different suffixes). Payment times 2026-03-15T08:12:03Z and 2026-03-15T08:12:05Z.

Priya: Quick log snippet from webhook handler (stripped):
```
{
  "event": "invoice.payment_succeeded",
  "id": "evt_3K...",
  "data": {"object": {"id": "in_1J...","charge": "ch_1Jabc"}}
}
```
Two events within 2s. Webhook delivery: stripe retried once but both deliveries returned 200.

Sam: Hmm. If both deliveries returned 200, Stripe won't retry further. Possibility: our handler is not idempotent for invoice events — we create invoice records and then create charges even if same charge id seen twice. Can you paste full webhook headers/body for the two deliveries? Need the stripe-event-id.

Marissa: Paste from ticket — customer attached both email receipts. Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/5482 (internal). I copied the webhook IDs from Stripe: evt_3Kabc and evt_3Kabd.

Priya: Found it in Stripe dashboard: evt_3Kabc (delivered at 08:12:03) and evt_3Kabd (delivered at 08:12:05). Both show response 200 from our endpoint /webhooks/stripe. The charge id is the same (ch_1Jabc) for both, but our DB shows two invoice records because we keyed by webhook.payload.id + created_at instead of charge id. That's a bug.

Priya: I'm going to refund the duplicate invoice now. Refund via stripe CLI:
```bash
stripe refunds create --charge ch_1Jabc --metadata reason=duplicate,refund_ticket=5482
```
I'll refund the later one (INV-20260315-9989).

BillingBot: Refund initiated: refund_1Kxyz (pending). Amount: $9,200.00 USD. Initiated by Priya.

Priya: Refund completed: refund_1Kxyz — succeeded. I've attached the refund receipt to ticket 5482 and emailed Acme.

Tomas: For long-term fix: add server-side dedupe by charge id + invoice number on webhook processing, and enforce idempotency keys on any DB writes. Also add an alert when >1 invoice created within 10s for same account. I'll open an ops issue.

Sam: I'll pick up the code change for the webhook handler. Plan: 1) check if charge id exists before creating invoice, 2) make DB invoice create idempotent with unique constraint on (account_id, charge_id). I'll open PR #2145 and link it here.

Marissa: Customer confirmed refund is visible and asked for a short note explaining what happened. I sent the note and CC'd Priya.

Liam: Great work. Action items: Priya — add a postmortem blurb to the ticket; Sam/Tomas — PR and monitoring rule; Marissa — close ticket once PM confirms wording. Target to close by EOD. :white_check_mark:
